script_logic: 1. Attempt to resolve original pinned commit (2346c30c...) on remote
2. If commit not found, fetch latest from origin/HEAD
3. Record resolution method in event envelope
5. If both succeed, pass workflow; if not, record TOKEN_VAZIO + next step

must_preserve: Both success and failure paths recorded
No implicit promotion of TOKEN_VAZIO to PASS

rollback.action: Mark as UNRECOVERABLE_PERMANENT; escalate to human review
rollback.preserve: All investigation and decision logs; do not delete attempt history

r3.F_gap: Actual resolution commit not determined without network access or git ls-remote execution
